mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT gt.subject_id FROM grant_table gt WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER' UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT ud.user_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_dept ud ON ud.dept_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' AND ud.status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT up.user_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_post up ON up.post_id = gt.subject_id WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'POST' AND (up.status IS NULL OR up.status = 0)
